newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia posts 77.6 million losses in 1996.
- First group of Chechen pilgrims to arrive in Jeddah on Thursday.
- Sri Lanka to open consulate in Jeddah on April 11.
- Ministry of Agriculture and Water agrees to set up 35 agricultural projects worth 87 million riyals.
- Saudi Arabia's oil exports to New Zealand in 1996 reached 862.5 million riyals.
- Ministry of Agriculture and Water to build four water desalination plants.
- Interior minister confirms arrival of Iraqi plane carrying pilgrims at Jeddah airport.
